name: yield
title: Yield
description: What the holdings earn and how they move with interest rates, as of a date (default today). A rate belongs to a currency: an aggregate row is one entity in one currency, plus a value-weighted total (quality mixed). Views: global (per currency and a total, with duration and dv01: the whole portfolio's rate risk); sources, portfolios, accounts; positions (per holding; columns=+coupon,maturity_date,price on request); securities (each security, direct and through funds: a bond's coupon, maturity, price, implied yield and rating (columns=+rating), a stock's earnings yield, P/E, dividend yield, payout and growth); funds (each fund: what its lines imply, its page's yields and duration, as of when); cash (each balance, term deposit and money-market fund with rate, benchmark and gap, worst paid first); curve (DV01 per currency and tenor: 3M, 1Y, 5Y, 10Y, 30Y); coverage (what the figures rest on, what is missing, where each dividend's record day comes from). income_yield: the next twelve months' projected income over value; implied_yield: what the price implies; dv01: the value's fall per basis point. Read quality. Example: {view: "cash"}.

converted.description: global, sources, portfolios and accounts: one row per entity in the output currency (default false).

currency.description: Output currency, e.g. USD or CHF. Default: the configured one.

filter.description: Conditions, all of which hold: ["value > 1000", "date >= 2025-07", "category not in Rent, Groceries"].

from.description: With period: the series' start (YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD, today, yesterday, last month, last year).

limit.description: Most rows to return (default: as many as fit).

max_chars.description: Most characters the result may take (default 16000); the page ends at a row boundary and the last line says how to get the rest.

period.description: global, sources, portfolios, accounts and curve: a series at the end of each period of from/to (default: the last twelve months).

search.description: Keep rows with this text in any cell.

sort.description: Column to sort by; "-" for descending. "-value": the main money column, largest first whatever the sign.

symbol.description: positions, funds and cash: keep only rows whose symbol contains this text.

to.description: With period: the series' end, same forms. Default today.
